# RQ-REBASE-PHANTOM-4136

## Publication boundary

Existing PR only: https://github.com/ashlrai/phantom/pull/4136
Do not create a replacement PR or publish this job with a new branch.
The final task rule prohibits commits, pushes, tags and publication. All changes
are therefore uncommitted. The existing PR has NOT been updated or enqueued.

## Source evidence

- PR observed open, head `009fba7dc33cc64a031435e231a801000fe6cfe3`,
  fork `masonwyatt23/phantom`, branch `codex-bridge/RQ-DRAIN3-PH-02`.
- Original PR parent: `65d714ece34d2dcd48f50e283835d4cae41699c4`.
- Fetched default branch: `e78a1e0fd182e8a118abeccfddf62d96b3d73baa`.
  Worktree is detached there; the original job branch was not moved.
- Applied a three-way merge preview as an uncommitted working-tree delta.
  Recovered shallow ancestry with `git fetch --deepen=100 origin master`;
  confirmed the original PR parent is the merge base.
- Hosted CI run `42540771086`: Merge Gate failed because Quick typecheck's
  authority check failed. Core compilation passed. CODEOWNERS lacked six new
  Tier-1 tests. Vercel is non-required and was not changed.

## Reconciliation

- Resolved four conflicts: retained bus and connect storage documentation;
  retained `lstat` plus local-routing imports; kept the equivalent sorted-key
  assertion; regenerated CLI docs with current observability and connect help.
- Retained current default-branch doctor failure severities for failed Locus
  reports and provider-registry exceptions; no diagnostic control was weakened.
- Updated only `autonomyDirection.productionVelocity.maxSlotsPerBackend` from
  3 to 1 in the three JSON fixtures, matching upstream #4212 / #4471; documented
  the current empty-home throughput ramp. The final byte comparisons pass.
- Updated the daemon-activity regression to read `status-readiness.ts` after
  extraction, and require its source match to exist rather than pass vacuously.
- Independent read-only review confirmed all 123 original fleet-status function
  bodies remain token-identical after extraction and conflict resolutions retain
  both sides' behavior.

## Commands and verification

- `gh pr view 4136 -R ashlrai/phantom --json state,mergedAt,closedAt,url,headRefName,headRefOid,baseRefName,title`: failed to read local gh config
  (operation not permitted). Connected GitHub metadata, status, workflow jobs and
  Quick typecheck logs supplied read-only evidence instead.
- `npm install -g @ashlr/phantom`: failed EPERM; existing `phm` 3.30.24 used.
- `phm docs --agent --json`, `phm mcp list --json`, `phm wire status --json`:
  completed; gateway not wired. No config or credential changes made.
- `git fetch origin master`, `git fetch --deepen=100 origin master`.
- `git merge-tree --write-tree`: four content conflicts; shallow-history attempt
  initially refused unrelated histories, then ancestry was recovered.
- `git switch --detach e78a1e0fd182e8a118abeccfddf62d96b3d73baa`; applied merge
  preview with `git diff --binary <base> <preview-tree> | git apply`.
- `npm run install:worktree`: PASS; pnpm 10.28.2, dependency and compiler-cache
  healing completed. Initial missing tsgo was repaired by this sanctioned path.
- `node scripts/generate-cli-docs.mjs`: PASS, 419 lines generated.
- `npm run check:docs`: PASS, 262 local links / 402 source links / 0 errors.
- `git diff --check`: PASS after trimming the imported extra EOF blank line.
- Authority regeneration, typecheck, lint, changed-file verification and affected
  tests: final results below. All test invocations used temporary HOME.

## Verification results

- `npm run typecheck`: PASS (backend and web).
- `npm run authority:regen`: PASS (2 generation tests across 2 suites).
- First `node scripts/verify-changed.mjs`: FAIL in authority verification,
  9 passed / 1 failed: whole-tree CODEOWNERS scan exceeded its unchanged 30s
  timeout (47.7s measured). No missing ownership assertion was reported;
  Tier-1 closure verification passed. Later lint/compiler stages were not reached.
- Main affected suites: 410 passed / 19 failed on the first run (429 total,
  16 files). Failures: 14 five-second timeouts, 2 live-process identity assertions,
  3 stale JSON fixture values.
- Supplemental suites: 143 passed / 2 failed (145 total, 5 files). Both failures
  were timeouts: fleet-memory-state's snapshot case and standing-merge-pass's
  rolling daily-cap case. Doctor suites passed 67 tests; no controls weakened.
- Retried ONLY the 16 timeout cases together with the same timeout limits and one
  worker: 16 passed. The other 246 cases in those files were filtered out for
  this retry only; their original results remain recorded, not discarded.
- JSON fixture diagnostics: repeated with JSON and default reporters into /tmp;
  field comparison isolated the slot default drift. After the surgical fixture
  update: 3 passed / 0 failed.
- Distinct behavior-test outcome across original runs and targeted retries:
  572 passed / 2 failed (574 exercised). The two m49 live-activity cases require
  `/bin/ps -o lstart= -p <pid>`, denied by this host with operation not permitted.
  Missing `tickInProgress` / `childActivity` is the intended fail-closed behavior
  when the process owner cannot be verified. No test or security bypass added.
- CODEOWNERS later passed all 6 cases unchanged; closure passed all 4 cases.
- Final `node scripts/verify-changed.mjs`: PASS, including all 10 authority tests,
  changed-file ESLint, tsgo, lane integrity and console sync-I/O checks. It warns
  about 17 unchanged real-I/O test files; no touched-file violation remains.
- Full-repository `npm run lint`: FAIL, 15 errors / 268 warnings in ESLint.
  All error files are byte-identical to fetched default-branch HEAD:
  `src/web-ui/routes/verse/fleet-board/work-result-form-340.test.tsx` (1 explicit-any),
  `test/leader-reply-clean-original-238s.test.ts` (2 control-regex),
  `test/leader-status-reply.test.ts` (1 control-regex), `tmp_fleet-recheck.ts`
  (11 unused variables/imports). No unrelated source or lint controls changed.
  Its chained lane/sync-I/O commands were not reached; the final changed-file
  verifier independently ran those checks and reported the unchanged lane warnings.
- No hosted green or queue claim is made. Local preparation is complete; publication
  and enqueue remain prohibited by the task's final no-commit/no-push rule.
